findings.title: BundleConfig.pb does not request 16 KB native library alignment
findings.message: Native libraries are packaged uncompressed, but BundleConfig.pb does not request PAGE_ALIGNMENT_16K.
fix: Upgrade bundletool / AGP so the bundle config requests 16 KB alignment
